title: Iohn Leo
summary: Raleigh names Iohn Leo in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iohn Leo, who writes that the Soldan of Aegypt, after Saladine, had vnder him a Viceroy stiled Eddaguadare. He is not Iohn the Apostle, and not Iohn of Gischala. The one-word title would fold onto john, so the title is two words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
